principle: M3 is an authored continuation of the accepted 31-quest campaign, not a parallel second campaign. Reuse a current milestone as a prerequisite only when the earlier capability is genuinely needed by the new operation; do not force completion of unrelated weapon/key branches merely to lengthen progression.

borrowed-access.name: Access Protocol: Customs
borrowed-access.reason: The existing campaign first establishes practical Customs key/access familiarity. Borrowed Access then changes the player decision from possessing representative keys to proving one restricted route can actually support an operation.

contractor-intercept.name: Access Protocol: Reserve
contractor-intercept.reason: The player should already have completed Admiral's Reserve access milestone before being trusted to protect a timed movement window there.

observation-window.name: Arsenal Protocol: Precision - Fieldwork
observation-window.reason: Observation Window is not another basic sniper qualification. It is the first authored field problem that applies already-proven precision competence to route control.

internal-security.name: Access Protocol: Clearance
internal-security.reason: Internal Security explicitly assumes the player already earned Admiral's Labs clearance. The capstone must not grant, bypass or narratively fake access.

explicitNonDependencies.reason: The operation is about inconspicuous equipment, not restricted access. Sharing Interchange does not justify a key-branch gate.
The operation is about movement/protection tradeoff. Requiring a Shoreline key milestone solely because both use the map would be artificial progression.
The operation already has a meaningful prerequisite in Acoustic Discipline; key ownership has no role in the field-awareness decision.
Heavy Assault tests protective fieldcraft and does not prescribe an assault-rifle family. A weapon-domain gate would be cosmetic coupling.
Rogue perimeter disruption occurs in open operational space and does not depend on the key-access capability represented by the historical Lighthouse milestone.
